sys: Port of Vostochny, Kozmino Bay oil terminal
t: Kozmino (port of Vostochny): harbour master, VTS and terminal calls for tankers
au: Harbour master of the seaport of Vostochny (port control in Kozmino Bay, call sign "Козьмина-АМП Восточный"), FGBU AMP of Primorsky Krai and the Eastern Arctic; VTS Находка-Трафик
ap: All ships in the port of Vostochny, whatever their flag; the Kozmino rules are for tankers going to or from the oil berths in Kozmino Bay.
apq: Настоящие Обязательные постановления подлежат исполнению судами независимо от их национальной и ведомственной принадлежности ...

when.x: Arrival information to the harbour master through www.portcall.marinet.ru (Vostochny p. 22); times per the General Rules: 120 to 72 hours before, confirm 48 to 24 hours before (see ru-general-prearrival). From a foreign port also FSB agreement (ru-entry-fsb-permission).

Tankers for the Kozmino oil terminal get VTS permission to enter Nakhodka Gulf (CH 13, line Cape Likhacheva to Cape Povorotny, see ru-vts-nakhodka-sector-2). If no berth or anchor place is free, wait for VTS permission to enter Kozmino Bay (p. 57). A tanker in ballast may, with the harbour master's permission, anchor at anchor place A before berthing; it goes to anchor place A without a pilot (p. 64).

Kozmino Bay traffic is regulated by the VTS on CH 13 (Находка-Трафик) and by the harbour master on CH 14 (Козьмина-АМП Восточный) (p. 24). Pilot boarding for the Kozmino berths at 42 42.86N 132 57.60E (p. 26). Tankers reduce to minimum steerage speed when approaching the pilot station; after the pilot boards, the tanker turns to starboard with tugs and follows the Cape Kozmina leading line to the turning circle (p. 37). Mooring alongside, bow towards the bay exit, with tugs (pp. 71, 72). The terminal operator tells the harbour master 1 hour before mooring that the berth is ready (p. 67).

Radio watch: at the Kozmino berths, continuous watch on CH 14 and CH 29 (p. 98); at anchor in the port, CH 14 and CH 16 (pp. 62, 96). Ships alongside tankers watch CH 14 and 29 and leave at once on the harbour master's order (p. 74). No talk unrelated to safety on CH 13, 14 and 29 (p. 99).

Departure application to the harbour master not later than 4 hours before departure (General Rules p. 45). Leaving the berth with pilot and tugs, through the turning circle, then without tugs to the Cape Kozmina leading line, leaving buoy No. 1 (42 43.30N 132 56.26E) to port (p. 42). Pilot disembarks at 42 42.86N 132 57.60E (p. 31). If bunkering or clearance is not finished after loading, the tanker leaves the berth with pilot and goes to anchor place A (p. 66).

ver: All paragraphs, coordinates, channels and call signs copied from the consolidated text of the Vostochny regulations (legalacts.ru, ред. от 13.02.2026). 2015 amendments (№ 142, 242, 364) read separately and found included; 2026 amendment № 62 read on the official PDF (adds RPK Vostochny-1 berth row only). New 2027 regulations read on rulaws.ru and first page of the official PDF. Contacts from an archived 2023 page because pma.ru returned HTTP 403.
nt: Kozmino is in the seaport of Vostochny, not in Nakhodka. Current text is the 2011 regulations as amended, valid until 01.03.2028; new regulations (order № 337 of 17.07.2026, rulaws.ru shows № 331) replace them from 01.03.2027 with the same Kozmino channels (CH 13 Находка-Трафик; CH 14 Козьмина-АМП Восточный; CH 29 Lake Vtoroye; watch CH 14 and 16 at anchor and at berths, CH 14 and 29 at berths and alongside tankers in Kozmino). New rules from 2027 also: mooring at Kozmino only with wind up to 14 m/s and visibility at least 10 cables (same as now), oil loading stops above 15 m/s wind or 1 m waves. Weather limits now: Kozmino mooring at wind up to 14 m/s and visibility not less than 10 cables (p. 70). Tankers and other oil ships may not use the port as a storm refuge (p. 9). Harbour master phone and email for Kozmino were not found in an official source reachable from here (pma.ru blocked); the numbers given are the port administration head office from 2023 and must be checked with the agent. The terminal call signs Козьмина-1 / Козьмина-2 on CH 10 are as printed in the regulations; the terminal operator may use other channels in its own port information.

From a foreign port the entry permission must also be agreed with the FSB (ru-entry-fsb-permission).

Crossing the line Cape Likhacheva to Cape Povorotny: call Nakhodka Traffic on CH 13 (ru-vts-nakhodka-sector-2). Pilot boarding for Nakhodka Bay berths at 42 48 00N 132 56 24E; for the Novitsky Bay oil terminal at 42 45 50N 132 56 24E (pp. 31, 32). In Nakhodka Bay work the harbour master on CH 69 (Находка-5); in Novitsky Bay on CH 34 (Новицкий-5).

Anchoring, weighing anchor and mooring only with the harbour master's permission (p. 25). Ships under way keep watch on CH 13 (p. 86). Tugs: CH 74 or 96 in Nakhodka Bay, CH 34 at the Novitsky oil berths (p. 87). Pilot order cancelled at least 1 hour before (p. 35). Daily forecast by the VTS at 14.30 local time (p. 102).

Kozmino, Nakhodka), AMP of the Sea of Okhotsk and Tatar Strait (Vanino, De-Kastri), AMP of Sakhalin, Kuril Islands and Kamchatka (Prigorodnoye, Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky)

apq: Настоящие Общие правила обязательны для исполнения экипажами судов и внешними экипажами автономных судов, независимо от их флага и прав на них, а также физическими и юридическими лицами, осуществляющими деятельность в морских портах Российской Федерации (далее - морские порты) и на подходах к ним.

when.x: The harbour master enters the arrival information into the port state control system (SGPK) not later than 72 hours and not earlier than 120 hours before the planned arrival, from information sent by the master, owner or agent. So the arrival information must reach the harbour master between 120 and 72 hours before arrival. If the passage from the last port is shorter than 72 hours, it is entered before the ship leaves the last port. Quote: "не позднее 72 часов и не ранее 120 часов до планируемого времени захода судна в морской порт ... В случае если переход судна из последнего морского порта ... составляет менее 72 часов, капитан морского порта организует и контролирует внесение информации о заходе судна в морской порт в СГПК перед выходом судна из последнего морского порта" (General Rules p. 39).

The master, owner or agent confirms the arrival information to the harbour master between 48 and 24 hours before the expected arrival. Quote: "Информация о заходе судна в морской порт подтверждается капитаном судна ... либо морским агентом капитану морского порта в период между 48 и 24 часами до ожидаемого захода судна в морской порт." (p. 40).
If the port of destination changes, the master, owner or agent sends the harbour master a message cancelling the arrival information (p. 41).

Not later than 4 hours after the ship first anchors in the port waters or finishes its first mooring, the master, owner or agent sends the harbour master the arrival application with the p. 38 data plus the actual date and time of arrival, the ship's place in port (anchorage or berth) and the bunkers on board (heavy, light and gas fuel separately). Quote: "не позднее четырех часов после первой постановки судна на якорь в акватории морского порта или окончания первой швартовки судна в морском порту направляет капитану морского порта заявление о приходе судна в морской порт" (p. 43).

For departure clearance the master, owner or agent sends the harbour master the departure application not later than 4 hours before the expected departure, but not before arrival clearance is finished (p. 45). The departure permission is valid 24 hours from the harbour master's stamp on the crew list (p. 54).

nt: Practical: give the agent the full p. 38 data 120 to 72 hours before arrival, confirm 48 to 24 hours before, and send the arrival application within 4 hours of first anchoring or mooring. For a ship coming from a foreign port the earliest possible notice matters, because the FSB may take up to 48 hours to agree the entry (ru-entry-fsb-permission). The old General Rules (Приказ № 140 of 2009, then № 463 of 2017) are replaced; the Vostochny regulations p. 22 still cite "пунктами 47 - 48, 50 - 51 Общих правил" of the old 2009 rules, but the times above are the current ones. Each port's own regulations may add more (see the ru-vts-* and ru-port-* records). No 'не менее чем за 72 часа' wording was found in the current Far East port regulations; the 72/120 h and 48-24 h windows come from the General Rules. The General Rules are valid until 01.09.2028.

sys: Entry permission agreed with the FSB (Указ № 502)
t: Russia: entry permission for ships from foreign ports, agreed with the FSB, and possible underwater hull inspection
au: Harbour master of the port of call, with agreement of the authorised official of the FSB (Federal Security Service, includes the Border Service)
ap: Ships coming to a Russian seaport from a foreign port (for example Ulsan to Kozmino). The underwater hull inspection is for ships coming from foreign ports through the territorial sea of foreign states with a stay in their ports, when the FSB official decides it is needed.
apq: заход в морские порты Российской Федерации судов, следующих из иностранных портов, осуществляется с разрешения капитана морского порта, согласованного с должностным лицом органа федеральной службы безопасности.

when.x: The trigger is the normal arrival information (General Rules p. 38 to 40, sent 120 to 72 hours before arrival). Within 1 hour of receiving it the harbour master passes it to the FSB official together with information on the ship's last 10 ports of call. Quote: "не позднее одного часа после получения ... информации о заходе судна в морской порт ... информирует о планируемом заходе судна в морской порт должностное лицо органа федеральной службы безопасности с представлением указанной информации, а также информации о последних 10 портах, в которые это судно осуществляло заход." (Rules approved by Government Decree № 1867, p. 2).

The FSB official decides within 48 hours from receiving the information: agree the permission, refuse it, or require an inspection of the underwater hull. Only after agreement does the harbour master put the ship in the daily traffic schedule. If refused, the harbour master tells the master, owner or agent and the VTS operator 24 hours before the planned arrival that the ship may not enter (Rules p. 3, 6, 7).

If an underwater inspection is ordered: it is done before the ship enters the port, by the receiving terminal operator (divers or technical means). The operator agrees time and place with the harbour master and the owner; the harbour master informs the FSB at least 6 hours before. The master signs the inspection act and supplies the statement that there are no suspicious objects or explosive devices on board; one of the 4 copies stays with the master. A port may stop access, movement and port operations for an arriving ship that was not inspected when inspection was required (inspection Rules p. 5 to 11; Decree № 1637/1651 amendments).

how.to: Harbour master of the port of call (who forwards to the FSB)

nt: Decree № 502 is issued under the Federal Constitutional Law on martial law (1-ФКЗ). Practical for Ulsan to Kozmino: make sure the agent files the arrival information as early as allowed (up to 120 hours before arrival) and has the last 10 ports; the FSB may take up to 48 hours. Expect that the port may order a diver or ROV hull inspection before entry, usually at a waiting area named by the harbour master; the cost can be charged to the ship. Kozmino to Vladivostok is a voyage between Russian ports, so this FSB agreement step should not apply to Vladivostok (it is for ships from foreign ports), but the normal arrival information still does. Not found: any separate report by a foreign merchant ship to the Border Service (ПУ ФСБ) on crossing the state border or entering the territorial sea when bound for a port; the border, customs and fisheries authorities receive the arrival and departure information from the harbour master (General Rules p. 51). Follow any instruction from Border Service ships or VTS.

Navigation and weather information on CH 67 and 71 (p. 129); daily forecast by VTS at 14.30 local time (p. 131); storm warnings on CH 16 (p. 130). Times and order of passage through ice are set by the harbour master for 10.00 each day and published on www.pma.ru. Jingtang port area (about 119 00E) is east of the east line and is not in this system. when.x: 7 days before the expected arrival (or on leaving the last port if the voyage is shorter than 7 days), the ship or agent sends the application for entry of an international ship to the maritime administration of the port for approval. (第六条)

24 hours before the expected arrival (or on leaving the last port if the voyage is shorter), the ship or agent reports to the inspection authorities the arrival time, berth or anchorage, berthing and shifting plan and crew and passenger details. (第七条)

Dangerous cargo (incl. crude oil in bulk): 24 hours before entering or leaving port (or before leaving the last port if the voyage is shorter than 24 hours) the applicant makes the dangerous cargo declaration to the maritime administration and gets approval before entering or leaving. (第二十一条)
If entry formalities were not completed before arrival, complete them within 24 hours of arrival. (第八条)

Within 4 hours before leaving (or on arrival if the stay is under 4 hours) complete exit formalities and get the port clearance. If the ship has not sailed within 24 hours of clearance or things change, report again. (第十二条, 第十三条)

nt: The agent handles these; the officer should check the agent has the ETA and that the dangerous cargo approval is in place before the pilot station. when.x: VTS arrival pre-report, sent on the internet by the company or agent at least 24 hours before entering the VTS subarea (if the voyage is shorter than 24 hours, on leaving the last port). Not for ships only passing through. Site www.dpn.com.cn, menu 'VTS抵港预报'. Content: ship's name, call sign, ETA, draught, cargo, ship size (type). The port operator also files the berthing plan 24 hours before berthing. (VTS抵港预报: 船舶进入VTS分区前（过路船除外），必须提前24小时（航程不足24小时的，应在离开上一港口时），由船公司或者代理，在互联网上提交VTS抵港预报。)

Entry report when crossing the report line (north line A-B-C, west line C-D, south line D-E or east line E-F). Content: ship's name or call sign, position, draught, purpose of entry, other information the VTS asks for. (进港报告: 通过报告线 ... 船名或呼号，船位，吃水，进港目的，大连交管中心要求的其它信息。)

Arrival report on reaching a berth or anchorage in the subarea: ship's name or call sign, berth or anchor position, time of berthing or anchoring. (抵港报告: 船舶抵达VTS分区内泊位或者锚地 ... 船名或呼号，抵达的泊位或锚位，靠泊或锚泊时间等。)

Sailing report before leaving the berth or weighing anchor: ship's name or call sign, berth or anchorage, time of unberthing or weighing anchor, destination. (开航报告: 船舶离泊或起锚前 ... 船名或呼号，所在泊位或锚位，离泊或起锚时间及目的地等。)

Activity report before and after: towing or speed trials in a fairway, shifting berth, engine trials, sea trials, compass testing. Ship's name or call sign, position, other information. (活动报告: 应在以下行动之前和结束之后报告: 航道内拖带或测速；调整泊位；试车，试航和测试磁罗经等。)

Accident report at once by all available means: ship's name or call sign, nationality, time, place, cause, help needed, damage, other information. Abnormal situation report (aids to navigation out of order, obstructions, drifting objects): at once by all means, with position. Anchoring in an emergency outside anchorages: report at once. (事故报告 / 异常情况报告: 采用一切有效手段报告大连交管中心。)

aq: 大连湾和大窑湾VTS分区的范围为以下五点顺序连结与岸线之间的水域，以大三山岛灯塔(38°51.9′N，121°49.5′E)所在经线为界，以西水域为大连湾VTS分区、以东为大窑湾VTS分区：A:38°51′48″N，121°41′30″E；B:38°45′00″N，121°41′30″E；C:38°45′00″N，122°06′00″E；D:39°00′00″N，122°06′00″E；E:39°01′52″N，121°57′45″E。大连湾VTS分区报告线：西报告线为A、B两点连线；南报告线为B、C两点连线；大窑湾VTS分区报告线：东报告线为C、D、E三点连线；南报告线为B、C两点连线。
ver: Area points, channels, report rules and contacts read from the copy of the rules and guide on mcrrc.top (whole text). Copy of the official text on mcrrc.top (maritime law database run by Shandong Jiaotong University). The Liaoning MSA site www.ln.msa.gov.cn, where the original is published, could not be reached from here; the notice number of the 2022 issue is not shown in the copy. Point X is computed (line B-C meets the lighthouse meridian); the meridian line X-L continues north to the coast. Xingang oil terminal and Dagushan lie east of the meridian, so in this subarea (the guide's pilot areas are named '大窑湾、新港港区').
nt: Official boundary: south line B-C (shared with Dalian Bay subarea) and east line C-D-E; the west side is the meridian of Dasanshan lighthouse. Other channels in the guide: Dalian pilots CH 12, Dalian port control CH 13, Dayaowan container terminal CH 11, Dalian Xingang oil terminal control (大连新港油码头调度) CH 14, tugs (大连港轮驳公司) CH 17/26, Dalian Petrochemical control CH 71. Pilot boarding areas (0.5 NM radius): No. 1 38 54.00N 121 56.50E; No. 2 for VLCCs, ore carriers and LNG carriers 38 52.00N 121 56.50E; No. 3 (forecast wind over force 6 or waves over 1.5 m) 38 56.00N 121 56.50E. Anchorages in the guide: Xingang tanker anchorage (新港油轮锚地) 38 55 00N-38 56 48N, 121 59 00E-122 02 00E; Xingang cargo anchorage 38 53 00N-38 55 00N, 121 57 30E-122 02 00E; Dayaowan cargo anchorage. No anchoring in fairways, basins or no-anchoring areas; report emergency anchoring at once. Ship-to-ship in anchorages must follow MSA rules and be reported. Special weather (wind above limits, poor visibility, ice) brings traffic control; obey VTS (rules art. 13, 14, 26). The rules and guide came into force on 2022-05-01 with 5 years validity (to 2027-04-30), replacing 辽海指挥〔2020〕74号. Check for a newer issue after the Liaoning coastal routeing system (in force 2026-08-15).

t: Dalian VTS, Lushun New Port subarea
au: Dalian MSA (大连海事局), Dalian VTS Centre (大连交管中心)
ap: Foreign ships, and Chinese passenger ships and other Chinese ships of 300 GT and over. Chinese ships under 300 GT may take part. Military, fishing and sports craft are not covered unless stated. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
apq: 第四条 在大连VTS区域内航行、停泊和作业的外国籍船舶和中国籍客船、300总吨及以上其他船舶，应当向大连交管中心报告。300总吨以下的中国籍船舶，可以自愿参加本规则规定的船舶报告制度。 (指南) 除另有明文规定外，军用船舶、渔业船舶和体育运动船艇不适用本指南的报告要求。

when.x: VTS arrival pre-report, sent on the internet by the company or agent at least 24 hours before entering the VTS subarea (if the voyage is shorter than 24 hours, on leaving the last port). Not for ships only passing through. Site www.dpn.com.cn, menu 'VTS抵港预报'. Content: ship's name, call sign, ETA, draught, cargo, ship size (type). The port operator also files the berthing plan 24 hours before berthing. (VTS抵港预报: 船舶进入VTS分区前（过路船除外），必须提前24小时（航程不足24小时的，应在离开上一港口时），由船公司或者代理，在互联网上提交VTS抵港预报。)

Entry report when crossing the report line (north line A-B, west line B-C or south line C-D). Content: ship's name or call sign, position, draught, purpose of entry, other information the VTS asks for. (进港报告: 通过报告线 ... 船名或呼号，船位，吃水，进港目的，大连交管中心要求的其它信息。)

Arrival report on reaching a berth or anchorage in the subarea: ship's name or call sign, berth or anchor position, time of berthing or anchoring. (抵港报告: 船舶抵达VTS分区内泊位或者锚地 ... 船名或呼号，抵达的泊位或锚位，靠泊或锚泊时间等。)

Sailing report before leaving the berth or weighing anchor: ship's name or call sign, berth or anchorage, time of unberthing or weighing anchor, destination. (开航报告: 船舶离泊或起锚前 ... 船名或呼号，所在泊位或锚位，离泊或起锚时间及目的地等。)
Departure report when crossing the report line out of the subarea: ship's name or call sign, time of crossing, position. (离港报告: 船舶通过报告线离开VTS分区 ... 船名或呼号，通过报告线时间，船位等。)
Change report when the pre-reported plan changes: the items that changed. (变化报告: 船舶预报计划信息发生变化 ... 变化的项目。)
Pilot report when the pilot boards and leaves: ship's name, time, place, pilot's name or number. (引航报告: 引航员登离轮 ... 登船及离船的船名、时间、地点及引航员姓名或编号等。)

Activity report before and after: towing or speed trials in a fairway, shifting berth, engine trials, sea trials, compass testing. Ship's name or call sign, position, other information. (活动报告: 应在以下行动之前和结束之后报告: 航道内拖带或测速；调整泊位；试车，试航和测试磁罗经等。)

Accident report at once by all available means: ship's name or call sign, nationality, time, place, cause, help needed, damage, other information. Abnormal situation report (aids to navigation out of order, obstructions, drifting objects): at once by all means, with position. Anchoring in an emergency outside anchorages: report at once. (事故报告 / 异常情况报告: 采用一切有效手段报告大连交管中心。)

Ships only passing through the subarea: report on entering and leaving it: ship's name, call sign, MMSI, position (lat/long or from a landmark), course, speed, last port, destination. (过路船舶报告: 进入、驶离 ... VTS分区时 ... 报告船名，呼号，海上移动业务识别号，位置（经纬度或相对于陆标的位置），航向，航速，始发港，目的港。)

t: Dongjiakou VTS (Qingdao port, Dongjiakou port area)
au: Dongjiakou MSA (中华人民共和国董家口海事局), Dongjiakou VTS Centre (董家口海事局船舶交通管理中心, 董家口交管中心)
ap: Foreign ships; Chinese ships of 300 GT and over; passenger ships; ships carrying dangerous goods; ships restricted in their ability to manoeuvre; ships receiving oily water or waste, bunkering, supplying water, doing construction or lightering; others who join by choice. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
apq: 第四条 以下船舶通过董家口VTS报告线时，应通过甚高频无线电话或其他有效手段向VTS中心进行船舶动态报告：（一）外国籍船舶；（二）300总吨及以上中国籍船舶；（三）客船;（四）载运危险货物的船舶；（五）操纵能力受到限制的船舶；（六）从事油污水等污染物接收、油水供给、工程施工、过驳作业等活动的船舶；（七）其他自愿参加VTS动态报告的船舶。

when.x: Entry report: when passing a reporting line, or before heaving up anchor in the anchorage: ship's name, position, movement and anything else the VTS asks. (进港报告 报告时机：船舶通过报告线或锚地起锚前 … 报告内容：船名、船位、动态及VTS 中心询问的其他信息。)
Arrival report: on arrival at the berth or anchorage in the VTS area: name, position, movement, other. (抵港报告 报告时机：船舶抵达VTS区域内泊位或者锚地。)

Departure report: before leaving the berth, shifting or heaving up anchor: name, position, movement, other. (开航报告 报告时机：船舶离、移泊或起锚前。) Rules art. 5 also asks for a report before going into or out of the channel.
Outbound report: when passing a reporting line: name, position, movement, other. (离港报告 报告时机：船舶通过报告线。)
Change report: when the pre-arrival plan details change: the items that changed. (变化报告 报告时机：船舶预报计划信息发生变化 报告内容：变化的项目。)

Accident report (traffic accident or pollution: details); abnormal situation report (anything that may endanger traffic); before crossing a channel or a temporary control area (only with VTS consent). (事故报告；异常情况报告；第九条 穿越航道、临时交通管制区 … 经VTS中心同意 …)

Activity report before starting and when finished: opening up main engine, boiler, windlass, steering gear or other gear that affects manoeuvring; trials; compass adjusting; launching lifeboats or rafts; going alongside or lightering at anchor; works in or under water; towing; oily water or bunker/water supply work; other work affecting safety. (活动报告 应在作业开始前和结束时报告 …)
Pilot report: after the pilot boards or before he leaves: pilot's name or number, ship's name and call sign, boarding or landing place, destination. (引航报告 报告时机：引航员登轮后或离轮前。)

ver: Rules, user guide, points, channels and contacts read from the official .doc attached to the Shandong MSA notice of 1 April 2022 (sd.msa.gov.cn); same as the mcrrc.top copy. Points are printed in seconds and copied as printed (the source mixes ′ and ＇ for minutes).
nt: Valid to 30 April 2027 (art. 32), so a new version may come out in 2027. The VTS area is the 11 points H to G joined in the printed order and closed by the port coastline. Reporting lines: first line A-B (abeam Qingshilan light beacon, 青石栏灯桩), second line C-D-E-F-G. Pilotage is compulsory for foreign ships and for VLCCs. Pilot boarding areas (user guide): LNG ships and draught 19 m or more: No. 1 area 35°20′.30N 119°59′.80E; 35°18′.75N 120°01′.42E; 35°17′.68N 119°59′.93E; 35°19′.18N 119°58′.32E. Draught 12 m to under 19 m: No. 2 area 35°27′.18N 119°52′.35E; 35°25′.68N 119°53′.97E; 35°24′.61N 119°52′.49E; 35°26′.11N 119°50′.86E. Draught under 12 m: No. 3 area (5 points, see source). Main channel 318°39′16″ / 138°39′16″, max draught 22.8 m, one way for 300,000 t ships on the tide. No anchoring outside the anchorages, no lightering or going alongside at anchor, and no trials in the channel or anchorages without approval. Foreign ships may not enter Lingshan Shuidao without approval. Not checked: later Dongjiakou anchorage notices (e.g. the LNG emergency anchorage, 鲁航通〔2024〕0779号).

t: Dongying VTS (Dongying port)
au: Dongying MSA (中华人民共和国东营海事局), Dongying VTS Centre (东营海事局船舶交通管理中心)
ap: Foreign ships; Chinese ships of 500 GT and over; passenger ships; ships carrying dangerous goods; ships restricted in their ability to manoeuvre; others who join by choice. Not military, government, fishing or sports craft. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
apq: 第四条 除军用船、公务船、渔船和体育运动船舶外，下列船舶在VTS区域内航行、停泊和作业时，应通过VTS工作频道或其他有效手段向VTS中心报告：（一）外国籍船舶；（二）500总吨及以上中国籍船舶；（三）客船；（四）载运危险货物的船舶；（五）操纵能力受到限制的船舶；（六）其他自愿参加VTS动态报告的船舶。

when.x: Inbound reports: 1) on reaching the Dongying VTS area limit; 2) on reaching the line between light buoys D1 and D2 of the 100,000 t channel; 3) after all fast. Content: ship's name, call sign and cargo; position; draught (first report); movement; other items. (进港报告 1.抵达东营VTS服务区域边界时 2.抵达东营港十万吨级航道D1、D2灯浮连线时 3.靠妥码头后 … 1.船名、呼号及载货 2.报告时的位置 3.船舶吃水（首次报告时）4.航行动态 5.VTS中心要求的其他信息。)

Outbound reports: 1) before leaving the berth; 2) on leaving the line between light buoys D11 and D12 of the 100,000 t channel; 3) on leaving the Dongying VTS area limit. Content: name and call sign; position; destination; other. (出港报告 1.驶离码头前 2.驶离东营港十万吨级航道D11、D12灯浮连线时 3.驶离东营VTS服务区域边界时 …)

nt: The five points are an open line; the area is closed by the coast at both ends (inferred from the shape, the text says only 'water inside the line joining five points'). The first inbound calls (abeam Chaolian Dao and Zhucha Dao) are outside the printed VTS area: Chaolian Dao lies east of the outer limit at 120°35′04.5″E. Speed max 12 kn in traffic lane 1 of the main channel routeing; no overtaking for ships 50 m and over in the basins, Jiaozhou Bay channels, lane 1 and the deep water channel without VTS consent; foreign ships may not enter the 'fourth line' (第四线) or Lingshan Shuidao (灵山水道) without consent. Very large ships (draught 15 m or more) must use the deep water channel (points: 36°00′11.3″N 120°26′51.0″E; 35°59′25.2″N 120°31′02.0″E; 35°59′57.4″N 120°26′47.5″E; 35°59′11.4″N 120°30′58.1″E) with pilot on board, master on the bridge, chief engineer in the engine room, UKC at least 15% of draught, visibility 1.5 NM or more, wind not over Beaufort 8, waves not over 2.5 m, escort ready, convoy at least 2 NM apart; the pilot boards them abeam Xiaogong Dao (arts. 29 to 33). 2025 notice: dangerous goods ships (a laden tanker) do not use Chaolian Dao No. 1 anchorage; they anchor in the open water SE of Chaolian Dao, clear of other ships; foreign ships entering the territorial sea must also report to the designated MSA. The 2019 user guide (replaced, no new guide found) listed pilot areas: draught under 15 m in No. 2 precautionary area of the Qingdao routeing (36°01′.78N 120°19′.18E; 36°01′.13N 120°19′.02E; 36°01′.58N 120°20′.40E; 36°00′.90N 120°20′.20E); draught 15 m or more: circle 500 m round 35°58′.63N 120°34′.73E, or the area 35°51′.40N 120°16′.30E; 35°52′.30N 120°17′.60E; 35°53′.60N 120°17′.60E; 35°52′.80N 120°16′.30E. nt: Legal basis: Maritime Traffic Safety Law 2021. No time ahead is set: the report is made when entering the territorial sea; agents often send it shortly before. ver: Rules, user guide, points, channels and contacts read from the official .docx attached to the Shandong MSA notice of 3 March 2023 (sd.msa.gov.cn) and compared with the 54seaman.com copy: identical (the copy hides the email behind an address guard; decoded it is the same). Points printed as degrees, minutes and tenths (35°22′.9N) and copied with only the notation changed. In the Chinese user guide point G of the Lanshan line is shown as '***' in the 54seaman copy; the rules, the official file and the English guide all give G as 35°00′.0N 119°25′.7E.
nt: The reporting line A-H is also the area limit; the area is closed by the coast. Valid to 30 April 2028 (art. 32). Speed limit in the VTS area: passenger ships 15 kn, all other ships 12 kn (art. 14). No overtaking in basins or channels and no crossing of channels or anchorages without VTS consent. No entry, leaving or shifting when wind is force 8 or more (gusts included), visibility under 500 m or swell 3 m or more; VLCCs and LNG ships must meet special conditions (user guide part 6). The port operator, ship or agent must report entry, leaving and shifting plans in advance (art. 17; no hours given). Pilotage is compulsory for foreign ships (user guide part 3). Many fish farms and fishing boats near Rizhao and Lanshan, positions change with the season. VTS reports do not replace the port entry approval, the territorial sea report or arrival reports (art. 29). VTS works 0000 to 2400 Beijing time; VHF range 24 NM, radar 16 NM. Rizhao and Lanshan share one VTS Centre (address 101 Tianjin Road, Rizhao). Lanshan pilot boarding areas: South area No. 1 circle 500 m round 35°02′.25N 119°30′.00E (draught under 14 m and length under 250 m); South No. 2 circle 500 m round 35°03′.80N 119°37′.77E (draught 14 m or more or length 250 m or more); Middle area No. 1 circle 1500 m round 35°04′.50N 120°02′.50E (VLCC only, draught over 20.5 m); Middle No. 2 circle 1000 m round 35°07′.50N 119°46′.00E (draught 15.0 m to 20.5 m or length 300 m or more); Middle No. 3 circle 1000 m round 35°06′.00N 119°34′.00E (draught under 15 m and length under 300 m). Note: the VLCC pilot area and Middle No. 2 lie east of the line E-F (119°40′.6E), so outside the printed VTS area: call Lanshan VTS before you get there (practical advice, not printed). Dumping grounds: circle 1.5 km round 35°00′.00N 119°24′.00E; circle 1.0 km round 35°11′.00N 119°39′.38E.

ver: Rules, user guide, points, channels and contacts read from the official .docx attached to the Shandong MSA notice of 3 March 2023 (sd.msa.gov.cn) and compared with the 54seaman.com copy: identical (the copy hides the email behind an address guard; decoded it is the same). Points printed as degrees, minutes and tenths (35°22′.9N) and copied with only the notation changed.
nt: The reporting line A-F is also the area limit; the area is closed by the coast (English guide: 'surrounded by the coastline and joint lines'). Valid to 30 April 2028 (art. 32). Speed limit in the VTS area: passenger ships 15 kn, all other ships 12 kn (art. 14). No overtaking in basins or channels and no crossing of channels or anchorages without VTS consent. No entry, leaving or shifting when wind is force 8 or more (gusts included), visibility under 500 m or swell 3 m or more; VLCCs and LNG ships must meet special conditions (user guide part 6). The port operator, ship or agent must report entry, leaving and shifting plans in advance (art. 17; no hours given). Pilotage is compulsory for foreign ships (user guide part 3). Many fish farms and fishing boats near Rizhao and Lanshan, positions change with the season. VTS reports do not replace the port entry approval, the territorial sea report or arrival reports (art. 29). VTS works 0000 to 2400 Beijing time; VHF range 24 NM, radar 16 NM. Rizhao and Lanshan share one VTS Centre (address 101 Tianjin Road, Rizhao). Pilot boarding areas, Rizhao port: No. 1 circle 750 m round 35°18′.28N 119°38′.48E (draught under 16 m); No. 2 circle 750 m round 35°17′.30N 119°40′.82E (16 m to under 19.5 m); No. 3 circle 750 m round 35°16′.48N 119°46′.68E (19.5 m or more); No. 4 circle 500 m round 35°15′.50N 119°35′.00E; No. 5 circle 500 m round 35°12′.15N 119°43′.10E (draught 17.5 m or less and length 312 m or less); No. 6 circle 1000 m round 35°11′.00N 119°50′.00E (draught over 17.5 m); coal pier circle 500 m round 35°20′.30N 119°36′.70E. Dumping ground inside 35°17′.00N 119°36′.10E; 35°17′.00N 119°36′.90E; 35°18′.27N 119°36′.10E; 35°18′.27N 119°36′.90E. Lanshan is a separate sector on CH 09 (see cn-vts-rizhao-lanshan).

t: Tianjin VTS (Tianjin port, incl. Nanjiang and Dagang oil terminals)
au: Tianjin MSA (天津海事局), Tianjin VTS Centre (天津海事局船舶交通管理中心, "天津VTS")
ap: Ships and facilities that navigate, stay or work in the Tianjin MSA VTS area, and their owners, operators and agents. The pre-arrival (24 h) report applies to every ship; the 4 h sailing plan applies to all foreign ships.
apq: 本规则适用于在天津海事局船舶交通管理系统（以下简称VTS系统）的区域内航行、停泊和作业的船舶、设施（以下简称船舶）及其所有人、经营人、代理人和有关单位及人员。（2017年版第二条）

when.x: Ship, owner, operator or agent: at least 24 h ahead, in writing or other effective way, report to the VTS centre the ETA, ship name, flag, call sign, draught, ship type, dimensions, cargo, last / next port and other data asked for. Voyage under 24 h: report before leaving the last port. ETA change over 2 h or other main data change: report the change at once. (2017 text, art. 5) (船舶或其所有人、经营人、代理人应至少提前24小时将船舶预计抵达时间、船名、国籍、呼号、吃水、船舶种类、船舶尺度、载货情况、驶来（往）港及主管机关要求的其他资料，以书面或其他有效的方式报告VTS中心。航程不足24小时的，应在驶离上一港前报告。船舶预计抵达时间变更超过2小时……应及时……报告VTS中心。)

All foreign ships: report the sailing plan (航行计划) to the VTS centre 4 h before entering or leaving port or shifting in port. Ships using the lock or opening bridges add the expected times. Any change to the plan: report at least 2 h ahead. (2017 text, art. 6) (所有外国籍船舶……进出港或在港内移泊，应提前4小时向VTS中心报告船舶航行计划……航行计划如有变更，应至少提前2小时向VTS中心报告。)

On VHF, report ship name, position, movement and anything else the VTS asks: when crossing the VTS gate line (VTS门线) and the set report lines. If VHF contact fails, use every other means and get it confirmed. (2017 text, art. 9 (1)) (通过VTS门线及规定的报告线)

Also report name, position and movement on VHF: before entering or leaving a channel; before entering or leaving the lock; before passing an opening bridge; before turning in a channel; before crossing a channel; before weighing anchor; after anchoring; before unberthing; after berthing. (2017 text, art. 9 (2) to (10)) (驶入（出）航道前；……占用航道调头前；穿越航道前；起锚前；锚泊后；离泊前；靠泊后。)

Dagu lighthouse report point on the main channel (大沽灯塔船舶报告点): inbound, report on VHF14 when passing it; outbound, report on VHF09. Entering or leaving the channel west of Dagu lighthouse: report on VHF14; east of it: VHF09. Dagusha channel (Dagukou port area): VHF10. Dagang channel (Dagang port area, oil terminals): VHF08. Coming from a Tianjin anchorage or straight from the approach: report on the channel of the zone the ship is in. (2017 text, art. 27 and 28)

Before and after: repairs to main engine, steering gear, windlass, radio, boilers or other equipment that affects manoeuvring; sea trials or engine trials; lowering boats for drills; fumigation. (2017 text, art. 10)

At once: traffic accident, pollution, accident to crew or passengers, or other emergency. Promptly: faulty aids to navigation, obstructions or floating objects, ships in distress, pollution. (2017 text, art. 11 and 12)

Anchoring in a channel, harbour basin, channel junction or no-anchoring area only in special cases and only after asking the VTS centre and getting permission. Overtaking in a one-way channel only in emergency, with the other ship's consent and after telling the VTS. (2017 text, art. 23 and 19 (4))

how.n: Zone 1: all waters not in zones 2 to 5 (VTS area outside the port, approaches, anchorages). Also given as the enquiry channel in the 2020 notice.
Zone 2: Xingang lock to west of Dagu lighthouse, channel and waters inside the breakwaters (Xingang / Nanjiang).
Zone 3: Haihe lower reach channel, incl. Xingang lock.
Zone 4: Dagusha channel and waters inside its breakwaters, south to the line 1000 m north of the Dagang channel. Gaoshaling channel also uses VHF10 (2023 notice).
Zone 5: Dagang channel and waters inside its breakwaters, and waters south of the line 1000 m north of the Dagang channel (Dagang oil terminals).
Standby working channels (2017 text).
Enquiries (2020 notice). Country code +86.

ver: VTS gate line, report events, zones and channels read from the 2017 edition of the rules (Word copy on 54seaman.com, an old official text). The 2020 notice on msa.gov.cn confirms a new edition from 2020-10-16 (5 years), VHF09 and the phone. The 2023 Gaoshaling notice (msa.gov.cn) confirms zones 4 (VHF10) and 5 (VHF8) still exist. The Bohai Bay central routeing (2026) names Tianjin VTS on VHF09/16. The 2020 and 2023 texts themselves were not seen: tj.msa.gov.cn did not answer.
nt: OLD TEXT. The full rules here are the 2017 edition. The 2020 edition (津海通航〔2020〕116号) changed some VTS report points and report items, changed the Dagang channel rules and removed the pilot clauses; it was valid 5 years, to about 2025-10-16, and was amended again in 2023 (2023年第1号). No replacement or extension was found on msa.gov.cn; tj.msa.gov.cn could not be reached. Check the current rules with the agent or Tianjin VTS (VHF09, 022-25700692) before arrival. Report points other than the gate line and Dagu lighthouse are not listed here (not in the text seen). The VTS gate line is an arc of 20 NM round the given point, closed by the coast. Tanker notes: ships carrying flash point below 23 C bulk liquids count as 'special dangerous cargo ships' (载运特殊危险货物船舶) with stricter one-way traffic limits in the main channel. Ships may not enter or leave port when visibility is under 1000 m, wind force 9 or more, or ice signal 3 or more (2017 text art. 24). National reports (port entry, dangerous cargo declaration, territorial sea) are separate records.

(外国籍船舶应当在紧急进入中华人民共和国内水的同时向当地海事管理机构紧急报告 ...)

If AIS does not work properly after entry, a ship under way reports every 1 hour: name, call sign, IMO number; present position, intended course and speed; until she leaves internal waters or gets the permit to enter port.
The ship must follow the orders and supervision of the maritime administration while in internal waters.

t: Yantai VTS, Bajiao sector (Yantai West Port, incl. the crude oil terminal)
au: Yantai MSA (中华人民共和国烟台海事局), Yantai VTS Centre (烟台船舶交通管理中心)
ap: Foreign ships; passenger ships; ships carrying dangerous goods; ships restricted in their ability to manoeuvre; Chinese ships of 300 GT and over; ships receiving oily water or other waste; others who join by choice. Not military, government, fishing or sports craft. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
apq: 第四条 除军用船、公务船、渔船和体育运动船外，下列船舶在VTS区域内航行、停泊和作业时，应按规定向VTS中心进行船舶动态报告：（一）外国籍船舶；（二）客船；（三）载运危险货物的船舶；（四）操纵能力受到限制的船舶；（五）300总吨及以上中国籍船舶；（六）从事油污水等污染物接收的船舶；（七）其他自愿参加VTS动态报告的船舶。

when.x: Entry report on reaching the reporting line: ship's name, position, movement and other items the VTS asks; ships with dangerous goods also give the kind and quantity; towing ships give the tow's name and length. (驶入报告：驶抵报告线时报告船名、船位、航行动态以及VTS中心要求的其他事项,载有危险货物的船舶还应报告所载危险货物种类、数量，拖带船舶应当报告拖带物名称、拖带长度。)
Arrival report after berthing or anchoring: name, berth or anchor position, time completed. (到达报告：靠泊或锚泊后报告船名，泊位或锚位，完成时间。)
Shift report before shifting: name, present berth or anchorage, berth or anchorage you are going to. (移泊报告：移泊前报告船名，当前泊位或锚地，预抵泊位或锚地。)
Sailing report before sailing: name, departure position, expected time of entering the channel, next port. (开航报告：开航前报告船名，离港位置，预计进入航道的时间和下一港。)

Anchoring / heaving up report before anchoring or heaving up in an anchorage: name, position; when heaving up to go in, also the berth, and the time and position of entering the channel. (抛/起锚报告：在锚地抛/起锚前应报告船名、船位，起锚进港时还应报告拟靠泊位、预计进入航道的时间、位置。)
Before crossing a channel, a routeing area, the Penglai-Changdao route or a temporary control area: report before entering and cross only with permission (rules art. 7).

Before starting and after finishing: opening up boilers, main engine, windlass, steering gear or main navigation equipment; sea or engine trials; going alongside at anchor; towing connect or let go; oily water or waste handling; other work affecting safety (art. 11).

Emergency and abnormal reports at once by every means: accident, pollution, machinery damage, injury, security incident; aids to navigation not normal, obstructions, drifting objects (arts. 8 and 9). Pilots report boarding and leaving: ship, time, place, pilot's name or number (art. 12).

ver: Rules, user guide, centres, radii, channels and contacts read from the official .docx attached to the Shandong MSA notice of 3 March 2023 (sd.msa.gov.cn), compared with the mcrrc.top copy: same. Positions printed in degrees and decimal minutes and copied with only the notation changed.
nt: Reporting line = the 9 NM circle round the West Port 300,000 t pier head light beacon; the area is the water inside it (closed by the coast). Anchorages (user guide): No. 5 pilot and quarantine anchorage 37°51′N 121°15′E; 37°48′N 121°15′E; 37°51′N 121°20′E; 37°48′N 121°20′E (part of it lies just outside the 9 NM circle by the printed figures, a computed check). No. 6 pilot and quarantine anchorage 37°51′N 121°06′E; 37°49′N 121°06′E; 37°51′N 121°09.2′E; 37°49.5′N 121°09.2′E. Approach from Chengshan Jiao (鲁航通〔2024〕0029号, 2024): ships bound for the West Port are advised to use the Chengshan Jiao to Changshan Shuidao public route (north limit 37°44′02″N 122°51′32″E; 37°55′30″N 121°25′54″E; 37°59′23″N 121°07′23″E; south limit 37°32′49″N 122°37′09″E; 37°54′41″N 121°04′49″E) and turn in at a suitable place; the inshore Yantai to Weihai route is closed by fish farms. Yantai VTS has six sectors, each with its own channel: Zhifu CH 09, Bajiao (West Port) CH 10, Penglai and Changdao CH 11, Longkou CH 12, Laizhou CH 14, Changshan Shuidao and Penglai outer anchorage CH 08. Reports go to the Yantai VTS Centre ('calling Yantai VTS center', 呼叫烟台交管中心) on the channel of the sector you are in. Valid to 30 April 2028 (art. 34). No overtaking in harbour channels (art. 16). Terminal owners or agents must file entry, leaving and shifting plans in advance by internet or fax (art. 17; no hours given). Lightering or going alongside at anchor must follow MOT and MSA rules and be told to the VTS. Radar blind areas: basins and berths, east of Kongtong Dao, between Nan/Bei Changshan Dao and Daheishan Dao. VTS works 0000 to 2400 Beijing time. No email address is printed. Address: 8 Huanhai Road, Yantai. VTS reports do not replace the national port entry, territorial sea or arrival reports.

Not military, government, fishing or sports craft. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included. Ships passing Changshan Shuidao must also follow the Changshan Shuidao routeing system and ship reporting system (rules art. 5).
apq: 第四条 除军用船、公务船、渔船和体育运动船外，下列船舶在VTS区域内航行、停泊和作业时，应按规定向VTS中心进行船舶动态报告：（一）外国籍船舶；（二）客船；（三）载运危险货物的船舶；（四）操纵能力受到限制的船舶；（五）300总吨及以上中国籍船舶；（六）从事油污水等污染物接收的船舶；（七）其他自愿参加VTS动态报告的船舶。 船舶航经长山水道应遵守《长山水道船舶定线制》和《长山水道船舶报告制》。

when.x: Ships report when passing the reporting lines (entering the system): name of ship, call sign; position (latitude and longitude or bearing and distance from a landmark); course; speed; port of departure; port of destination; defects and limitations (towing ships give the length of the tow and the name of the object towed); length overall and gross tonnage. (长山水道报告：船舶驶入长山水道时报告：船名、呼号；位置（经纬度或相对于陆标的位置）；航向；航速；始发港；目的港；缺陷及限制（拖船应报告其拖带长度及被拖物名称）；总长及总吨。)
No report is needed when a ship leaves the system. (船舶驶出时，不需报告。)

A ship that wants to cross Changshan Shuidao reports ship's name and present position 15 minutes before entering the channel (English user guide only; the Chinese rules art. 7 ask for a report before entering any routeing area, with permission needed to cross).

Penglai outer anchorage (on CH 08): arrival, anchoring, heaving up and sailing reports as in the other Yantai sectors (name, anchor position, time; before heaving up the berth and the time and position of entering the channel).
Emergency and abnormal reports at once by every means (rules arts. 8 and 9).

nt: The sector is the TSS (north and south limits as lines, separation zone 0.2 NM wide and 23.5 NM long) plus the two precautionary areas at the ends. ap: Foreign ships; passenger ships; ships carrying dangerous goods; ships restricted in their ability to manoeuvre; Chinese ships of 300 GT and over; ships receiving oily water or other waste; others who join by choice. Not military, government, fishing or sports craft. A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
apq: 第四条 除军用船、公务船、渔船和体育运动船外，下列船舶在VTS区域内航行、停泊和作业时，应按规定向VTS中心进行船舶动态报告：（一）外国籍船舶；（二）客船；（三）载运危险货物的船舶；（四）操纵能力受到限制的船舶；（五）300总吨及以上中国籍船舶；（六）从事油污水等污染物接收的船舶；（七）其他自愿参加VTS动态报告的船舶。

when.x: Entry report on reaching the reporting line: ship's name, position, movement and other items the VTS asks; ships with dangerous goods also give the kind and quantity; towing ships give the tow's name and length. (驶入报告：驶抵报告线时报告船名、船位、航行动态以及VTS中心要求的其他事项,载有危险货物的船舶还应报告所载危险货物种类、数量，拖带船舶应当报告拖带物名称、拖带长度。)
Arrival report after berthing or anchoring: name, berth or anchor position, time completed. (到达报告：靠泊或锚泊后报告船名，泊位或锚位，完成时间。)
Shift report before shifting: name, present berth or anchorage, berth or anchorage you are going to. (移泊报告：移泊前报告船名，当前泊位或锚地，预抵泊位或锚地。)
Sailing report before sailing: name, departure position, expected time of entering the channel, next port. (开航报告：开航前报告船名，离港位置，预计进入航道的时间和下一港。)

Anchoring / heaving up report before anchoring or heaving up in an anchorage: name, position; when heaving up to go in, also the berth, and the time and position of entering the channel. (抛/起锚报告：在锚地抛/起锚前应报告船名、船位，起锚进港时还应报告拟靠泊位、预计进入航道的时间、位置。)
Before crossing a channel, a routeing area, the Penglai-Changdao route or a temporary control area: report before entering and cross only with permission (rules art. 7).

Before starting and after finishing: opening up boilers, main engine, windlass, steering gear or main navigation equipment; sea or engine trials; going alongside at anchor; towing connect or let go; oily water or waste handling; other work affecting safety (art. 11).

Emergency and abnormal reports at once by every means: accident, pollution, machinery damage, injury, security incident; aids to navigation not normal, obstructions, drifting objects (arts. 8 and 9). Pilots report boarding and leaving: ship, time, place, pilot's name or number (art. 12).

ver: Rules, user guide, centres, radii, channels and contacts read from the official .docx attached to the Shandong MSA notice of 3 March 2023 (sd.msa.gov.cn), compared with the mcrrc.top copy: same. Positions printed in degrees and decimal minutes and copied with only the notation changed.
nt: Reporting line = the 9 NM circle round Kongtong Dao lighthouse; the area is the water inside it. Misprint: the reporting-line table in the user guide gives the Kongtong Dao lighthouse as 37°42.384′N 121°08.147′E, which is near the West Port (Fengzishan radar station, 37°42.39′N 121°08.16′E); the rules give 37°33.73′N 121°30.85′E and the guide's area section 37°33.734′N 121°30.846′E. Use the rules. Anchorages in this sector (user guide): No. 1 pilot and quarantine anchorage 37°33.17′N 121°24.66′E; 37°33.48′N 121°25.60′E; 37°34.73′N 121°25.80′E; 37°34.27′N 121°24.38′E. No. 2 pilot and quarantine anchorage 37°40.50′N 121°29.25′E; 37°40.50′N 121°31.75′E; 37°39.00′N 121°31.75′E; 37°39.00′N 121°29.25′E. Tanker lightering anchorage (油轮过驳锚地) 37°38.83′N 121°24′E; 37°38.83′N 121°24.22′E; 37°38.62′N 121°24.63′E; 37°38′N 121°25.15′E; 37°38′N 121°24′E. Shelter anchorage 5 points (see source). Approach from Chengshan Jiao (鲁航通〔2024〕0029号, 2024): ships under 100,000 t to Zhifu Bay are advised to use the Yantai to Weihai public route (fish farms about 200 m south of its south limit); ships of 100,000 t and over use the Chengshan Jiao to Changshan Shuidao public route and turn in at a suitable place; the inshore Yantai to Weihai route is closed by fish farms. Yantai VTS has six sectors, each with its own channel: Zhifu CH 09, Bajiao (West Port) CH 10, Penglai and Changdao CH 11, Longkou CH 12, Laizhou CH 14, Changshan Shuidao and Penglai outer anchorage CH 08. Reports go to the Yantai VTS Centre ('calling Yantai VTS center', 呼叫烟台交管中心) on the channel of the sector you are in. Valid to 30 April 2028 (art. 34). No overtaking in harbour channels (art. 16). Terminal owners or agents must file entry, leaving and shifting plans in advance by internet or fax (art. 17; no hours given). Lightering or going alongside at anchor must follow MOT and MSA rules and be told to the VTS. Radar blind areas: basins and berths, east of Kongtong Dao, between Nan/Bei Changshan Dao and Daheishan Dao. VTS works 0000 to 2400 Beijing time. No email address is printed. Address: 8 Huanhai Road, Yantai. VTS reports do not replace the national port entry, territorial sea or arrival reports.

The port operator files the berthing plan and the pilot station the pilotage plan within 24 hours before. (船公司或者代理公司应当在船舶进入VTS区域前24小时（航程不足24小时的，应在离开最后港口时），在互联网上提交船舶抵港预报。)

Arrival report on reaching a berth, anchorage or temporary stop: ship's name, call sign, time of berthing or anchoring, position. After anchoring also give anchor position and time. (抵港报告: 船舶抵达泊位、锚地或临时停泊点 ... 船名、呼号（如有）、靠泊或抛锚时间、船位 ...)

Sailing report before unberthing or weighing anchor: ship's name, call sign, time, position, destination. Shifting berth, mooring to or leaving buoys, leaving an anchorage and other activities that affect safety: report the plan 30 minutes before and wait for approval; report when finished. (开航报告: 船舶离泊或起锚前 ... 规则第七条 ... 应提前30分钟向营口交管中心报告其活动计划，经同意后，方可进行。)
Leaving report on crossing the report line out of the area: ship's name, call sign, time of crossing, position. (离区报告: 船舶通过报告线离开VTS区域 ... 船名、呼号（如有）、通过报告线时间、船位等。)
Change report when the pre-reported plan or the anchor position or activity plan changes. (变化报告)
Pilot report when the pilot boards and leaves: ship's name, call sign, time, place, pilot's name or number. (引航报告: 引航员登离轮)

Accident, pollution or emergency: report at once by all means. Abnormal situations (aids to navigation out of order, obstructions, drifting objects): at once by all means. (水上交通事故报告 / 异常情况报告: 采用一切有效手段报告营口交管中心)

Bayuquan phones: pilots 0417-6269440, port control 0417-6269485. A national notice of 1984 (水监字〔1984〕132号) sets a foreign-ship prohibited area in western Liaodong Bay (see cn-rep-jinzhou notes); the routes to Yingkou are east of it.

ver: Coordinates parsed from the Annex 1 PDF of notice 2026-10 (law.go.kr download), point numbers checked to run 1 to n without gaps. NOT cross-checked with the KCG web page (that page does not carry the area as text).  Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr.  inside_hint is the point farthest from the boundary, computed from the polygon; it was not checked against a chart, so it may fall on an island.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Daesan VTS centre has three sub-areas: Daesan port and nearby waters (CH 12, Daesan VTS), near Janganseo (CH 67, Jang-an VTS), Boryeong port and nearby waters (CH 69, Boryeong VTS). KCG page lists 'ETA' (입항예정시각) in the entry report for Daesan; the notice itself (Annex 2) lists ETA only for Incheon, Jeju and Gyeongin coastal. Giving the ETA does no harm. KCG page: follow the Daesan port facility rules (Daesan Regional Office of Oceans and Fisheries notice). Pilot points: Sindo (36 51 47N 126 07 03E), 2nd Sindo (36 53 36N 126 06 00E, boarding only), Jang-an/Daesan (37 02 00N 126 16 30E), Boryeong (36 11 18N 126 18 27E). Quick record (user asked for speed): area, channel, call name and report rules from the notice; phone from the KCG page; not polished.

At once, if the ship sees an obstruction in a fairway or a marine accident that does or may endanger traffic in the area (Act art. 14(5)). (선박교통관제구역 내의 항로상의 장애물이나 해양사고 발생 등으로 선박교통의 안전을 해치거나 해칠 우려가 있다고 인지한 경우에는 지체 없이 이를 선박교통관제관서에 신고하여야 한다.)

ver: Coordinates parsed from the Annex 1 PDF of notice 2026-10 (law.go.kr download) and compared point by point with the Korea Coast Guard VTS web page for this centre: identical. Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Parts of this area outside the Korean territorial sea are an 'outside territorial sea VTS area' (영해 밖 관제수역): there the VTS only gives information and advice on request, and the reporting duty applies only inside the territorial sea (Act art. 3, 18-2; Decree art. 8(2), 11-2). In the Korea Strait the Korean territorial sea is only 3 NM from the straight baseline 1.5m Rock - Saengdo - Hongdo (Territorial Sea Decree art. 3, Annex 2). KCG page: speed 12 knots or less north of the line joining the NW end of New Port fairway No. 5 (N35-03-52, E128-46-49) and the NW end of Honamdo (N35-03-51.19, E128-47-27.2).

nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Parts of this area outside the Korean territorial sea are an 'outside territorial sea VTS area' (영해 밖 관제수역): there the VTS only gives information and advice on request, and the reporting duty applies only inside the territorial sea (Act art. 3, 18-2; Decree art. 8(2), 11-2). Donghae, Mukho, Samcheok and Okgye ports (CH 12, Donghae VTS), Deoksan to Uljin incl. Hosan (CH 14, Hosan VTS). Annex 2: in the Donghae area, report the ship's name 2 NM before the end of the breakwater of the destination port. nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Parts of this area outside the Korean territorial sea are an 'outside territorial sea VTS area' (영해 밖 관제수역): there the VTS only gives information and advice on request, and the reporting duty applies only inside the territorial sea (Act art. 3, 18-2; Decree art. 8(2), 11-2). In the Korea Strait the Korean territorial sea is only 3 NM from the straight baseline 1.5m Rock - Saengdo - Hongdo (Territorial Sea Decree art. 3, Annex 2). Jeju VTS also has the Jeju north coast area (CH 12, call Jeju VTS) south of 33 40N and the Jeju south coast area (CH 14, call Seogwipo VTS); they are not recorded here. A ship taking the Jeju Strait between Chujado / Yeoseodo and Jeju meets this area. Ships entering Jeju or Aewol port report when crossing the north reporting line, latitude 33 40N, on CH 12 (ship's name and position) (Annex 2).

Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr.  inside_hint is the point farthest from the boundary, computed from the polygon; it was not checked against a chart, so it may fall on an island.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Excluded area inside the ring (Annex 1, 13 points, Seongnamdo to Hajodo islands): 01 34 23 39N 126 03 16E; 02 34 24 24N 126 02 30E; 03 34 24 13N 126 00 34E; 04 34 22 42N 125 56 10E; 05 34 21 12N 125 55 45E; 06 34 18 19N 125 56 32E; 07 34 15 54N 125 58 51E; 08 34 13 20N 126 02 13E; 09 34 11 19N 126 11 14E; 10 34 15 39N 126 11 16E; 11 34 18 44N 126 05 17E; 12 34 22 31N 126 02 40E; 13 34 23 39N 126 03 16E. (Notation converted only.) Mokpo VTS centre has three sub-areas: Mokpo port and nearby waters (CH 14, Mokpo VTS), Dochodo to Eobuldo (CH 67, Jindo VTS), Anmado to Dochodo (CH 13, Shinan VTS). Position reporting lines (Annex 2): ships using the Mokpo-gu / Siahae / Jeongdeunghae routes report when crossing the south line, latitude 34 30 42N (north end of Jeodo), northbound, or the north line, latitude 34 37 25N (east end of Majindo), southbound: ship's name, position, and whether the ship uses the deep-water route or the Mokpo-gu/Siahae/Jeongdeunghae route. Southbound ships using the Myeongnyang Sudo route may skip it. Air draught report limits: Mokpo Bridge (목포대교) 45 m, Jindo Bridge (진도대교) 15 m (Annex 2). KCG page: watch CH 14, CH 67, CH 13 and CH 16; speed limits in Mokpo-gu (20 kn) and near Jangjwado (12 kn); Mokpo inner harbour 5 kn; submarine cable between Hwawon peninsula and Anjwado. Jindo Coastal page: follow the traffic separation schemes and the oil tanker prohibited area rules. Quick record (user asked for speed): area, channel, call name and report rules from the notice; phone from the KCG page; not polished.

ver: Duty, ship categories, report timing and form layout from the SAR Act and its Enforcement Rule as in force on law.go.kr (Act version 2026-09-22, Rule 2025-12-21) and the PDF forms 7 to 10. Service area, radio frequencies, phone, fax and e-mail from the KHOA Korean Notice to Mariners Weekly Edition 36 of 2021 (pages 14 to 16), compared with the 2016 edition (same area and ship list). Area corners built from the printed latitude and longitude limits.
nt: The law says the master 'shall' send these reports (통보를 하여야 한다), so it is mandatory for ships leaving a Korean port, but the Act has no fine for missing them (fines in art. 46 do not cover art. 33) and the Korean NtM words it as a request for positive participation. For a ship only passing through, whether Korea can require it outside its waters is not settled; treat it as expected practice. Ships fitted with a position transmitting device under the Ship Safety Act art. 30 may leave out the Position Reports (SAR Act art. 33(3)); whether this covers a foreign ship's AIS or LRIT was not confirmed, so send PRs unless the RCC says otherwise. The KCG notice designating the 'ship position reporting area' and the radio frequencies (Rule art. 14(4)) was not found on law.go.kr; the area and frequencies here come from the 2021 Korean NtM, which is five years old. The e-mail addresses are printed split over two lines in the NtM table and were joined; confirm them with the RCC (phone above) on first use. Practical: the Y line lets one report also join JASREP or AMVER (Form 7 notes). Kozmino and Vladivostok are north of 40N, so on the Ulsan to Peter the Great Bay run send the FR when leaving the area at 40N (or on arrival if you prefer, as the rule allows either).

A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.
apq: 법 제2조제3호 관제대상선박: 가. 국제항해에 취항하는 선박 나. 총톤수 300톤 이상의 선박. 다만, 「어선법」 제2조제1호에 따른 어선 중 국내항 사이만을 항행하는 내항어선은 제외한다. 다. 「해상교통안전법」 제2조제4호에 따른 위험화물운반선 ... 고시 제5조: 1. 법 제2조제3호가목부터 다목까지의 선박 2. 「해운법」 제2조제1호의2에 따른 여객선 3. 총톤수 300톤 미만의 선박 중 「선박설비기준」 제108조의5에 따른 자동식별장치를 설치한 다음 각 목의 선박 ...

when.x: Navigation report when entering the VTS area: 1) ship's name 2) position 3) destination 4) air draught (only ships that will pass a listed bridge or power line and are as high as or higher than its limit) 5) other items needed for traffic safety. 10 minutes before getting under way (from a berth or anchorage inside the area): 1) ship's name 2) position and planned time of sailing 3) destination 4) air draught (only if passing a listed bridge or line at or above its limit) 5) other items. (항행을 시작하기 10분 전: 1) 선박명 2) 선박의 위치, 항행예정 시각 3) 목적지 4) 수면상 최고 높이 ...)
When starting to navigate: 1) ship's name 2) call sign 3) time navigation started 4) other items. (항행을 시작할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 호출부호 3) 항행 시작 시각 4) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

Anchoring or mooring report when anchoring or mooring: 1) ship's name 2) call sign 3) time and position of anchoring or mooring 4) other items. (정박 또는 계류할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 호출부호 3) 정박 또는 계류 시각ㆍ위치 4) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

Pilot boarding: ship's name, pilot's name or code, time and place of boarding, destination, air draught, other items. Pilot leaving: ship's name, time and place. The master may let the pilot make these calls. (도선사가 승선할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 도선사 성명 또는 약호 3) 승선 시각ㆍ장소 4) 목적지 5) 수면상 최고 높이 ... 도선사가 하선할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 하선 시각ㆍ장소)
When entering an offshore wind farm (one in commercial operation): ship's name, position, other items. (해상풍력발전단지에 들어올 때: 1) 선박명 2) 선박의 위치 3) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

At once, if the ship sees an obstruction in a fairway or a marine accident that does or may endanger traffic in the area (Act art. 14(5)). (선박교통관제구역 내의 항로상의 장애물이나 해양사고 발생 등으로 선박교통의 안전을 해치거나 해칠 우려가 있다고 인지한 경우에는 지체 없이 이를 선박교통관제관서에 신고하여야 한다.)

ver: Coordinates parsed from the Annex 1 PDF of notice 2026-10 (law.go.kr download), point numbers checked to run 1 to n without gaps. NOT cross-checked with the KCG web page (that page does not carry the area as text).  Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr.  inside_hint is the point farthest from the boundary, computed from the polygon; it was not checked against a chart, so it may fall on an island.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Mokpo VTS centre has three sub-areas: Mokpo port and nearby waters (CH 14, Mokpo VTS), Dochodo to Eobuldo (CH 67, Jindo VTS), Anmado to Dochodo (CH 13, Shinan VTS). Position reporting lines (Annex 2): ships using the Mokpo-gu / Siahae / Jeongdeunghae routes report when crossing the south line, latitude 34 30 42N (north end of Jeodo), northbound, or the north line, latitude 34 37 25N (east end of Majindo), southbound: ship's name, position, and whether the ship uses the deep-water route or the Mokpo-gu/Siahae/Jeongdeunghae route. Southbound ships using the Myeongnyang Sudo route may skip it. Air draught report limits: Mokpo Bridge (목포대교) 45 m, Jindo Bridge (진도대교) 15 m (Annex 2). KCG page: watch CH 14, CH 67, CH 13 and CH 16; speed limits in Mokpo-gu (20 kn) and near Jangjwado (12 kn); Mokpo inner harbour 5 kn; submarine cable between Hwawon peninsula and Anjwado. Jindo Coastal page: follow the traffic separation schemes and the oil tanker prohibited area rules. Quick record (user asked for speed): area, channel, call name and report rules from the notice; phone from the KCG page; not polished.

Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr. Ring printed as points 01 to 08 and closed back to 01 by the text 'connected in order'.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Parts of this area outside the Korean territorial sea are an 'outside territorial sea VTS area' (영해 밖 관제수역): there the VTS only gives information and advice on request, and the reporting duty applies only inside the territorial sea (Act art. 3, 18-2; Decree art. 8(2), 11-2). In the Korea Strait the Korean territorial sea is only 3 NM from the straight baseline 1.5m Rock - Saengdo - Hongdo (Territorial Sea Decree art. 3, Annex 2). Pohang VTS has three sub-areas: Baekseok-Gugye (CH 10), Gugye-Yangpo incl. Pohang port and Yeongil Bay (CH 12), Yangpo-Jigyeong (CH 10). A ship leaving Ulsan northbound for Peter the Great Bay may pass close to or through the Yangpo-Jigyeong and Gugye-Yangpo areas (seaward limits 129 40 28.50E to 129 43 52E): if the track enters them inside the territorial sea, make the entry report on the channel of that sub-area. Check the track on the chart. Notice 2026-10 amended Annex 1; its supplementary provision says the amended text for the Baekseok-Gugye waters (백석항에서 구계항에 이르는 해역) applies only from 2027-02-01. So the Baekseok-Gugye area as printed is adopted but not yet in force; what applies there before 2027-02-01 (the earlier annex) was not checked. The other two Pohang sub-areas are in force. KCG page: listening watch VHF CH 12 and CH 16; speed limit 5 knots in Pohang old port; ships of 70,000 GT and over entering the Pohang New Port fairway have priority under VTS control.

ver: Coordinates parsed from the Annex 1 PDF of notice 2026-10 (law.go.kr download) and compared point by point with the Korea Coast Guard VTS web page for this centre: identical. Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr. Ring printed as points 01 to 28, closed back to 01.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Parts of this area outside the Korean territorial sea are an 'outside territorial sea VTS area' (영해 밖 관제수역): there the VTS only gives information and advice on request, and the reporting duty applies only inside the territorial sea (Act art. 3, 18-2; Decree art. 8(2), 11-2). In the Korea Strait the Korean territorial sea is only 3 NM from the straight baseline 1.5m Rock - Saengdo - Hongdo (Territorial Sea Decree art. 3, Annex 2). Pohang VTS has three sub-areas: Baekseok-Gugye (CH 10), Gugye-Yangpo incl. Pohang port and Yeongil Bay (CH 12), Yangpo-Jigyeong (CH 10). A ship leaving Ulsan northbound for Peter the Great Bay may pass close to or through the Yangpo-Jigyeong and Gugye-Yangpo areas (seaward limits 129 40 28.50E to 129 43 52E): if the track enters them inside the territorial sea, make the entry report on the channel of that sub-area. Check the track on the chart. Notice 2026-10 amended Annex 1; its supplementary provision says the amended text for the Baekseok-Gugye waters (백석항에서 구계항에 이르는 해역) applies only from 2027-02-01. So the Baekseok-Gugye area as printed is adopted but not yet in force; what applies there before 2027-02-01 (the earlier annex) was not checked. The other two Pohang sub-areas are in force. KCG page: listening watch VHF CH 12 and CH 16; speed limit 5 knots in Pohang old port; ships of 70,000 GT and over entering the Pohang New Port fairway have priority under VTS control.

A foreign crude oil tanker is always included.

When starting to navigate: 1) ship's name 2) call sign 3) time navigation started 4) other items. (항행을 시작할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 호출부호 3) 항행 시작 시각 4) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

Anchoring or mooring report when anchoring or mooring: 1) ship's name 2) call sign 3) time and position of anchoring or mooring 4) other items. (정박 또는 계류할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 호출부호 3) 정박 또는 계류 시각ㆍ위치 4) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

Pilot boarding: ship's name, pilot's name or code, time and place of boarding, destination, air draught, other items. Pilot leaving: ship's name, time and place. The master may let the pilot make these calls. (도선사가 승선할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 도선사 성명 또는 약호 3) 승선 시각ㆍ장소 4) 목적지 5) 수면상 최고 높이 ... 도선사가 하선할 때: 1) 선박명 2) 하선 시각ㆍ장소)
When entering an offshore wind farm (one in commercial operation): ship's name, position, other items. (해상풍력발전단지에 들어올 때: 1) 선박명 2) 선박의 위치 3) 그 밖에 선박교통의 안전에 필요한 사항)

At once, if the ship sees an obstruction in a fairway or a marine accident that does or may endanger traffic in the area (Act art. 14(5)). (선박교통관제구역 내의 항로상의 장애물이나 해양사고 발생 등으로 선박교통의 안전을 해치거나 해칠 우려가 있다고 인지한 경우에는 지체 없이 이를 선박교통관제관서에 신고하여야 한다.)

ver: Coordinates parsed from the Annex 1 PDF of notice 2026-10 (law.go.kr download), point numbers checked to run 1 to n without gaps. NOT cross-checked with the KCG web page (that page does not carry the area as text).  Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr.  inside_hint is the point farthest from the boundary, computed from the polygon; it was not checked against a chart, so it may fall on an island.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Parts of this area outside the Korean territorial sea are an 'outside territorial sea VTS area' (영해 밖 관제수역): there the VTS only gives information and advice on request, and the reporting duty applies only inside the territorial sea (Act art. 3, 18-2; Decree art. 8(2), 11-2). In the Korea Strait the Korean territorial sea is only 3 NM from the straight baseline 1.5m Rock - Saengdo - Hongdo (Territorial Sea Decree art. 3, Annex 2). Mokpo VTS centre has three sub-areas: Mokpo port and nearby waters (CH 14, Mokpo VTS), Dochodo to Eobuldo (CH 67, Jindo VTS), Anmado to Dochodo (CH 13, Shinan VTS). Position reporting lines (Annex 2): ships using the Mokpo-gu / Siahae / Jeongdeunghae routes report when crossing the south line, latitude 34 30 42N (north end of Jeodo), northbound, or the north line, latitude 34 37 25N (east end of Majindo), southbound: ship's name, position, and whether the ship uses the deep-water route or the Mokpo-gu/Siahae/Jeongdeunghae route. Southbound ships using the Myeongnyang Sudo route may skip it. Air draught report limits: Mokpo Bridge (목포대교) 45 m, Jindo Bridge (진도대교) 15 m (Annex 2). KCG page: watch CH 14, CH 67, CH 13 and CH 16; speed limits in Mokpo-gu (20 kn) and near Jangjwado (12 kn); Mokpo inner harbour 5 kn; submarine cable between Hwawon peninsula and Anjwado. Jindo Coastal page: follow the traffic separation schemes and the oil tanker prohibited area rules. Quick record (user asked for speed): area, channel, call name and report rules from the notice; phone from the KCG page; not polished.

Channel and call name from Annex 1; phone and fax from the KCG page; report rules from Annex 2 and 3 and the Act and Decree as in force on law.go.kr.  inside_hint is the point farthest from the boundary, computed from the polygon; it was not checked against a chart, so it may fall on an island.
nt: Keep a continuous listening watch and answer on the area's working channel (Act art. 14(4)). Distress, urgency and safety: VHF CH 16, DSC CH 70. VTS works 24 hours (Annex 1 notes 3 and 4). Masters must follow VTS instructions unless that is clearly unsafe, and then say why at once (Act art. 14(1)). The VTS can order ships to a safe place when a gale, storm surge or typhoon warning is in force or visibility is 500 m or less (notice art. 8). International ships of 3,000 GT and over must record VTS VHF exchanges and keep them 60 days (Decree art. 10(2) to (5)). Fines up to KRW 3 million for no report, a false report, no listening watch or no recording; up to KRW 2 million for not reporting a hazard (Act art. 27). Radar shadow areas inside the area are not covered (Annex 1 note 1). Yeosu VTS covers two sub-areas: Yeosu port traffic safety special sea area and nearby waters (CH 12; Yeosu port, anchorages outside port limits, sectors 1 and 2) and Gwangyang port and nearby waters (CH 67; sectors 3 and 4). Spare channel CH 10. Call Yeosu VTS on both. Position reporting line (Annex 2): when crossing the north reporting line, latitude 34 48 26N, report ship's name, position and destination: northbound on CH 67, southbound on CH 12. Air draught report limits: Yi Sun-sin Bridge (이순신대교) 60 m, Myodo Bridge (묘도대교) 40 m (Annex 2). The KCG page gives the bridge clearances as 76.5 m and 52 m. KCG page speed limits: traffic safety special sea area 14 kn (dangerous cargo ships 12 kn); inside Gwangyang port limits 12 kn (dangerous cargo ships 10 kn); 8 kn in parts of Yeosu old port and between the GS Caltex No. 1 product pier east end and Myodo channel buoy 78. No-passing section in Gwangyang (GS Caltex product pier east end to Samnam No. 4 buoy) for ships of 500 GT and over and 35 m or longer: leave on odd hours, enter on even hours. Anchor only where the VTS assigns. Quick record (user asked for speed): area, channel, call name and report rules from the notice; phone from the KCG page; not polished. Point 25 is printed without the dot after the number ('25 북위 34도 50분 41초...'); copied as point 25.

領海及び接続水域に関する法律 (Territorial Sea Act), e-Gov

ver: Law and ordinance texts from the e-Gov law API (current versions). Contact list and the 17 items cross-checked with the JCG English leaflet (Hakodate office, 2021).
nt: Innocent, continuous and expeditious passage needs no report. Waiting for a pilot in the pilot boarding area with the pilot flag up, or acting on an order or guidance from a Japanese authority, needs no notice (Ordinance art. 7). Changing the next Japanese port after entering the territorial sea is allowed if the ship heads there continuously, after the ISPS port entry notice (Ordinance art. 4(7)). Failure to notify is not itself fined, but JCG may board, advise and order the ship out; breaking the order: up to 1 year prison or JPY 500,000 fine (Act art. 12); obstructing inspection: up to 6 months or JPY 300,000 (art. 13). Sheltering in Japanese waters in bad weather (e.g. Kikonai Bay near Hakodate in winter) needs prior contact with the coast guard radio by VHF, and the JCG then gives the area to use; keep AIS on and answer CH 16. The Ulsan to Peter the Great Bay track stays far from Japanese waters. Japan has no VTS in the Tsushima Strait, the Sea of Japan or the Tsugaru Strait; JCG VTS centres are in Tokyo Bay, Ise Bay, Nagoya, Osaka Bay, Bisan Seto, Kurushima and Kanmon only (JCG listing found by search, not opened).

apq: Any ship regardless of tonnage, flag or type is welcome in the JASREP System as far as she is within the service area of the system. Participation is voluntary. (JASREP「日本の船位通報制度」は、広い海における任意の相互救助システムです。)

when.x: Sailing Plan when the ship leaves a port inside the service area or enters the area; if sent after departure or entry, as soon as practicable.
First Position Report at any time within 24 hours of departure or entry, then no less often than every 24 hours until the Final Report; more often in heavy weather.
Deviation Report whenever the ship is 25 miles or more off the original track, the destination changes, or the sailing plan changes.

nt: JASREP started in 1985, right after the 1979 SAR Convention came into force. The JCG pages and manual are old (manual 2009; page notices 2005 to 2009); the e-mail route is still listed. The web page says JCG checks on a ship that misses its 24 hour report, the 2009 manual says 27 hours; either way, keep PRs within 24 h. The bbox and 'lat_limit' shape are only a map aid: the JCG gives the area as roughly north of 17N and west of 165E without west or north limits. The Sea of Japan crossing from Ulsan to Peter the Great Bay is inside it. A KOSREP report with JASREP on the Y line asks Korea to pass it to Japan as well (KOSREP form notes); a direct JASREP SP by e-mail is simplest.
